title: Rory and the Rainbow
coverAlt: Rory the rabbit cheers on a green hill under a big rainbow

pages.text: Rain taps on the roof. Rory the rabbit looks up.
pages.alt: Rain falls on a little house with a red roof. Rory the rabbit stands in a puddle and looks up.

pages.text: The rain stops. Look, a rainbow!
pages.alt: The rain has stopped. A big rainbow shines over the hills, and Rory points up at it.

pages.text: Rory runs down the road to reach it.
pages.alt: Rory runs down a winding road toward the rainbow far away.

pages.text: The road ends at a rushing river.
pages.alt: The road stops at a wide, rushing river. Rory stands at the edge and says whoa.

pages.text: Rory ties reeds into a raft.
pages.alt: By the river, Rory ties a bundle of tall reeds with rope. A raft made of reeds lies on the grass.

pages.text: He rows the raft on the river.
pages.alt: Rory sits on his reed raft and rows across the river with a wooden paddle.

pages.text: Remy the raccoon waves. "Room on the raft?"
pages.alt: Remy the raccoon stands on a rock in the river and waves. Rory, on the raft, holds out a paw to welcome him.

pages.text: Then they see a robot, stuck in the mud.
pages.alt: From the raft, Rory and Remy see a blue robot stuck up to its middle in brown mud, waving its arms for help.

pages.text: Rory and Remy pull him out with a red ribbon.
pages.alt: Rory and Remy lean back and pull a long red ribbon. The robot pops out of the mud with a happy face.

pages.text: "Thank you! Ride in my rocket!" says the robot.
pages.alt: The happy robot points to its red and white rocket. Rory and Remy cheer.

pages.text: They land by the rainbow, in a field of roses.
pages.alt: The rocket has landed in a field of red and pink roses, right where the rainbow touches the ground. Rory, Remy and the robot smile.

pages.text: Rory, Remy, and the robot run and play!
pages.alt: Under the rainbow, Rory jumps for a red ball, Remy runs and the robot hops, with confetti everywhere.

pages.text: Sid the seagull lives by the sea.
The sun is up. The sand is warm.
Sid sees a sandwich on a seat.
"Sadie, may I have some?" says Sid.
Sadie gives Sid a bite.
"Thank you, Sadie!" Sid sings a song.
Sadie and Sid sit in the sand.
They dig a big sand hill.
Sid adds a seashell on top.
Oh no! The sea rolls in.
The sand hill is gone. Sid is sad.
"Silly Sid! We can make one more!" says Sadie.
Shay the shark is shy.
Shay hides in the shadow of a ship.
"Come and see the show!" shout the crabs.
Shay shakes her head.
Shimmer the seahorse swims by.
"Shay, come with me to the show!" says Shimmer.
Shay is not sure.
Shimmer shows Shay a shiny shell.
"Shake it in the show!" says Shimmer.
Shay shakes the shell. Shh, shh, shh!
The crabs cheer. "Shay, you are a star!"
Shay is not shy now. She shines!
Leo the lamb likes to leap.
Leo leaps by the lake.
A leaf lands on Leo's head.
"A lucky leaf!" Leo laughs.
Leo takes the leaf to Lucy.
Lucy is a lazy lizard on a log.
"Look, Lucy! A lucky leaf!" says Leo.
Lucy licks her lips. "Is it lunch?"
"No, Lucy! Let's make a leaf boat!"
They lay the leaf on the lake.
A ladybug rides the leaf boat.
Leo and Lucy wave. What luck!
Theo thinks it is a fun day.
Theo is thirsty. He sips a big drink.
Thump! Thud! What is it?
It is thunder! Theo hides his head.
Theo feels a bit scared.
Theo's pal Thea comes over.
"Theo, think of a fun thing!" says Thea.
Theo thinks of a thick, warm blanket.
Theo and Thea sit under a thick blanket.
Thea hums a tune. Theo taps his thumb.
Soon, no more thunder.
"Thanks, Thea!" Theo gives a big thumbs up.
Kip the kangaroo has a kite.
The kite has a long tail.
Kip hops up the hill.
Whoosh! The wind catches the kite.
Up, up, up goes Kip's kite!
Cody the cow comes to see.
"Can I hold it?" says Cody.
Cody holds the kite. The wind gets strong!
The kite carries Cody up in the air!
"Come down, Cody!" calls Kip.
Cody comes down in the corn.
Kip gives Cody a carrot. What a day!
Zoe the zebra woke up at the zoo.
It felt cold. Zoe got her coat.
Zoe pulled the zipper. Zip!
Oh no! The zipper got stuck.
Zoe called Zack the zookeeper.
Zack tugged the zipper. Zip, zip!
Zap! The zipper went up.
"Thank you, Zack!" said Zoe.
Zoe zoomed out to play.
Zoom, zoom, all around the zoo!
Zack gave Zoe a zucchini for lunch.
Zoe the zebra felt warm and happy.
Chip the chipmunk has chubby cheeks.
Chip chews on chestnuts.
It is chilly. Chip needs a cozy spot.
Chip checks the old chimney.
A chick is in the chimney!
"Cheep, cheep!" says the chick.
The chick is chilly too.
Chip shares his chestnuts.
Chip and the chick chat and chew.
They find a comfy chair.
Chip and the chick cuddle up in the chair.
"Cheers for a new pal!" chirps the chick.
Goldie the goose gets a gift.
The gift is a guitar!
Goldie goes to the garden.
Goldie plays a happy tune.
Gus the goat comes to the gate.
"Goldie, can I have a go?" asks Gus.
Gus gets the guitar.
Gus is no good at it!
Goldie shows Gus how.
Gus gets better and better.
The garden gophers come to hear.
Goldie and Gus give a garden show!
Jax the jaguar lives in the jungle.
Jax likes to jump and jog.
One day, Jax finds a jar of jam.
"Yum, jam!" Jax jumps for joy.
Jax cannot get the lid off the jar.
Along comes Jill the giraffe.
Jill gives the jar a twist.
Pop! The jar is open.
"Join me for jam!" says Jax.
Jax and Jill eat jam and drink juice.
Jill tells a joke. Jax giggles.
What a jolly day in the jungle!
This is a big bear. That is a little bee.
They are pals. They like to play.
"Let's go there!" says the bear.
There is a pond by the hill.
Then they see the ducks.
"Look at those ducks!" says the bee.
The ducks swim in a line.
"These seeds are for them," says the bee.
They toss the seeds to the ducks.
The ducks quack, "Yum, yum!"
Then the sun sets.
"That was the best day!" say the pals.
Toby the tiger has a tiny tuba.
Toby taps his toes.
"Too, too, too!" goes the tuba.
Tia the toucan comes by.
Tia likes the tune. She taps along.
Toby and Tia play for the town.
Ten turkeys come to hear.
The turkeys tap their toes too.
A tiny toad jumps on the tuba.
The toad sings a tune.
Everyone claps. Toby takes a bow.
"Time for tea!" says Toby.
Finn the fish lives by a big rock.
Finn has fast fins.
One day, Finn finds a feather.
"Whose feather?" asks Finn.
Finn swims far and fast.
Finn meets Fay the fox by the shore.
"Not my feather," says Fay.
Finn meets a family of ducks.
"Not our feather," they say.
Then a gull swoops down. It has no tail feather!
Finn gives the feather back. "Thank you!" says the gull.
Finn feels fine. What a fun day!
Val the van is in a valley.
Val goes to the village.
"Beep, beep!" goes Val.
Val takes a vase to Vicky.
Vicky puts a violet in the vase.
Val takes vegetables to the vet.
The vet shares them with the animals.
Val takes a violin to Vince.
Vince plays a very sweet tune.
The village comes to hear.
Vicky washes Val. Val looks very shiny.
"Thank you, Val!" says the village.
Penny the penguin has a pink pail.
Penny waddles down to the pond.
Penny finds a pebble. Then another pebble!
Penny puts the pebbles in the pail.
Pat the pig peeks in. "Can I paint them?"
Penny and Pat paint the pebbles.
Pink pebbles! Peach pebbles!
Polly the parrot lands on a pole.
"Polly! Come to our party!" says Penny.
Polly brings a pie to the party.
They put the pebbles in a row by the pond.
Penny, Pat, and Polly have a pebble party!
Nora the newt has a nice, neat nest.
Nora takes a nap.
Knock, knock! A noise wakes Nora.
It is Ned the newt. "My net is lost!"
Nora looks near the nest.
Ned looks by the old log.
"No net here," says Ned.
Nora spots a net up a tree.
Nora nudges it with her nose.
The net drops. "Neat!" says Ned.
Night falls. Nora makes noodles.
Ned eats noodles with Nora. What a nice night!
Dot the duck wants a pool to dive in.
Dot digs a hole. Dig, dig, dig!
Dan the dog comes to help.
Dan digs too. Dust flies!
The hole gets deep.
Down comes the rain.
The rain fills the hole all day.
Now Dot has a deep pool!
Dot dips her toes.
"Dan, let's dive!" says Dot.
Dot dives. Dan dives. Splash!
Dot is a happy duck. Dan is a happy dog!
Bo the bear has a big boat.
Bo puts a basket in the boat.
In the basket: berries, buns, and a banana.
Bo rows the boat to the beach.
A bee buzzes by. Buzz, buzz!
"Can I come?" asks Bella the bee.
Bo and Bella sit on the beach.
A ball bounces by the boat.
Ben the bunny wants the ball back.
Bo bumps the ball to Ben.
Ben and Bella and Bo eat berries and buns.
What a fun day at the beach, Bo!
Mia the mouse wants to make muffins.
Mia gets milk and a mixing bowl.
Mia mixes and mixes. What a mess!
Max the mole peeks in. "More milk?"
Max adds melon. Mia adds maple syrup.
Mia puts the muffins in the oven.
The moon rises over the meadow.
The muffins are ready at last!
Max and Mia munch muffins.
"Mia, may I take one to Molly?" asks Max.
Molly the moose says, "Many thanks!"
Mia, Max, and Molly share a meal under the moon.
